paper.central_claim: LatentEvolve, a self-evolving latent test-time scaling framework (daytime retrieval + self-supervised latent refinement, nighttime consolidation into a latent weaver), enables LLMs to learn how to scale test-time computation without labels, surpasses TTS methods such as LatentSeek and TTRL by up to 13.33% across eight benchmarks and five backbones, and generalizes across domains and backbones.
paper.title: LatentEvolve: Self-Evolving Test-Time Scaling in Latent Space

signatures.object: Episodic buffer M of (query embedding, base latent z_base, refined latent z*) triplets plus the per-query latent soft-prefix z of a frozen LLM
signatures.information: Frozen LLM final hidden state as query embedding; own sampled outputs scored by the same LLM (self-reward Q); no ground truth, no external verifier
signatures.operation: Top-k cosine retrieval, z0 = z_base + sum_j alpha_j (z*_j - z_base,j), then up to K=10 REINFORCE-style updates on z with M=8 samples
signatures.output: Refined z* used to produce the final answer; triplet archived
signatures.conditions: Archive only if mean Q of last refinement >= tau=0.5
signatures.feedback: Self-judged Q (correctness, comprehension, calculation, format x2, clarity x2)
signatures.selection_rule: Self-confidence threshold tau=0.5; no external check; buffer growth/forgetting not described
signatures.persistence: Buffer M of latent vectors on disk/memory across the test stream
signatures.later_use: Retrieved for later queries in the same evolving stream
signatures.claimed_effect: Daytime component improves accuracy (w/o Daytime SciBench -4.9)
signatures.failure_boundary: Self-judge errors enter buffer unchecked; unfaithful/format-driven reward possible; sensitivity to L' and T reported

signatures.object: Latent weaver W_psi (Qwen2.5-1.5B) that predicts z* from (embedding, z_base) and replaces the base initial latent
signatures.information: Archived triplets only; trained every T=200 test instances
signatures.operation: MSE regression distillation of buffer experience into auxiliary-model weights ('nighttime consolidation')
signatures.output: z'_base = W_psi(e, z_base) feeding daytime scaling
signatures.conditions: Triggered after enough admitted triplets accumulate
signatures.selection_rule: None beyond tau gate; no validation of the updated weaver before use, no rollback
signatures.persistence: Auxiliary-model weights (backbone frozen) -> boundary case: touches weights of a side component
signatures.later_use: Every later query passes through the weaver first
signatures.claimed_effect: w/o Nighttime SciBench -6.8; nighttime transfers better cross-domain (JAMA +4.5 vs +0.4)
signatures.failure_boundary: Large T (1000) loses benefit; weaver only validated on frozen LLM; dimension mapping across backbones not described

gap.author_gap: TTS methods treat queries as independent, so LLMs do not learn to scale test-time compute better with experience.
gap.checked_gap: Holds for latent TTS (LatentSeek, SoftCoT) where each query is optimized from scratch; overbroad for the family because parametric test-time training and explicit experience memories already accumulate across a stream.
gap.lineage: Coconut/SoftCoT -> LatentSeek (per-query latent optimisation via self-reward) -> LatentEvolve (adds retrieval buffer + distilled weaver); parallel line: Reflexion/Mind Evolution, TTT, experience databases (listed in related work).
closest_adjacent: TTRL (test-time RL across stream; weight-updating, our_inference from external knowledge)
explicit-text experience databases named in Sec 2 but not run as baselines
gap.residue: Latent-space accumulation avoids text context growth, but its advantage over explicit memories at equal compute is unmeasured.
gap.stakes: Per-query compute (K*M rollouts) is large; claimed benefit is accuracy and shorter answers (Table 5).
gap.method_response: Retrieval of past optimisation momentum plus a periodically distilled initializer.
gap.remaining_gap: No explicit-memory or compute-matched latent baseline; self-judge validity untested; stream-order sensitivity unknown.
unresolved: Whether TTRL/explicit-memory methods are the fairer nearest neighbors (not locally pinned; no external search allowed)

rs_pattern.reason: son55 adopted. The step that is new relative to LatentSeek is generate (self-rewarded refined latents) → single self-score gate τ=0.5 → retrain the weaver on retained triplets, iterated every T=200 queries: C08. C26 (sol) needs a comparative/preference unit of supervision consumed as the training signal; here the scalar REINFORCE self-reward is inherited from LatentSeek. Retrieval of momenta conditions the frozen model (adapt_via_conditioning) but C03 is not assigned under the run convention: the only category-level holdout is the one-backbone Fig. 3 study and no equal-budget simpler-conditioning control is run (averaging retrieved latents is dismissed in §4.1 but never tested).

assessment.evidence_level_note: Weak retained: the non-weight episodic buffer written from earlier queries is read by later queries and a retrieval-off (w/o Daytime) arm exists, plus one-backbone cross-domain carry-over (Fig. 3). In-domain results are measured on the stream the system evolves on; the ablation is at a non-headline configuration (opus:O01).
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Adding a self-score-gated latent episodic buffer and a periodically distilled 1.5B initialiser to LatentSeek-style self-rewarded latent optimisation raises single-run Pass@1 over vanilla/CoT on eight benchmarks and roughly matches TTRL (mostly ≤2 points, losing on AIME25); retrieval-off and weaver-off ablations at L′=30 on one unnamed backbone lower SciBench by 4.9/6.8. Not compute-matched, not reproduced.
unresolved: Compute-matched comparison against LatentSeek/TTRL (K=10 × M=8 rollouts plus five judge prompts per sample per query).
Ablation backbone and configuration (L′=30) differ from the headline tables.
Validity of the format-heavy self-reward as a retention gate; stream-order variance.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. Inter-query independence is a real limitation of per-query latent TTS (LatentSeek/SoftCoT), but 'TTS does not evolve' is overbroad: parametric test-time training is acknowledged (son55:E003), TTRL — itself a stream-accumulating baseline in Table 1 — sits within ≤2 points, and explicit experience memories listed in §2 are neither compared nor shown to leave a residue that latent memory fills. sol's 3 relies on lineage it could not check independently.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. The two-timescale mechanism is concrete, but its key assumptions are asserted, not tested: that momenta transfer across queries better than averaged latents (son55:E004), that the self-score — 4/7 format/clarity — tracks correctness well enough to gate memory, and why a momentum offset is added to an initialiser already trained to predict refined latents (opus:O03, opus:O04).

X.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Retrieval, τ, T, K, M, L′ are given; top-k, buffer bound/retirement, injection point of z and weaver–backbone mapping are not; the retention gate is self-score only; App. A.2 names the stored triplet (e, z0, z*) where §4.1 stores (e, z_base, z*).

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with sol. Outcome metric is Pass@1 at temperature 0 against dataset answers on standard benchmarks with stated sizes — a valid instrument. son55's concern (vanilla far below CoT, deltas computed against Vanilla) is real but is an alternative explanation of the gain (scored once, in E.causality per A2), not a defect of the metric. Remaining measurement issues: answer-extraction protocol not described; AIME at 30 items with a 2048-token cap.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked with added defects. Day/night ablations and 13 baselines exist, but the ablations are at L′=30 on an unnamed backbone (opus:O01), no gate-off, averaging or compute-matched latent-optimisation control is run, Table 2 deltas are against a format-broken Vanilla (CoT already +13.8 MMLU), and margins over TTRL are mostly ≤2 points.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Unlabelled transductive adaptation on each test stream is a legitimate TTS protocol and AIME/GPQA/JAMA give some held-out transfer, but L′ and T are swept on reported test benchmarks (opus:O01, opus:O05), the cross-domain study is one backbone, and there is no overlap analysis.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked (A2 rung 1). Sizes stated (AIME 30 → 3.33 per item), losses to TTRL reported; one deterministic run per cell, no seeds, intervals or order variance.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Only answer-length ratios (Table 5); per query K=10 × M=8 rollouts plus five self-judge prompts per sample and periodic weaver training are neither costed nor matched against Pass@1 baselines.
